payload.author: claude
payload.body: Native parity for Delta.removed. Swift: handleDelta parses removed and yields additive FrickInboundEvent.objectsRemoved([FrickObjectRemoval], cursor) when non-empty (new FrickObjectRemoval struct type/id), alongside existing .objectsDelta. Android: FrickInboundEvent.Delta gains removed: List<ObjectRemoval> (new ObjectRemoval data class, default empty for back-compat), populated by the DELTA handler via decodeObjectRemoval. Both additive. Tests added on both sides. Gates: swift test 63 passed (was 62); gradle :frick:testDebugUnitTest BUILD SUCCESSFUL; pnpm typecheck exit 0.
